abstract.p: How are you, Mostafa? Aren't you going to eat? Mostafa: Sorry, I was talking to the wife. This street food makes me nervous, right? Ahmed: Man, don't worry, this place is clean. Besides, this is Alexandrian koshary with yellow lentils, different from what you're used to. Mostafa: May God keep us safe. A man has to worry about his health for the kids. Ahmed: It's just one time, it won't hurt. The important thing is that we're sitting together. Mostafa: Thank God. You're right.
